questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: A T.V. tower has a height of $100m$. How much population is covered by T.V. broadcast, if the average population density around the tower is $1000{km}^{- 2}$
questions.solution:
Let $N$ is population covered

We know that

$d = \sqrt{2Rh}$

$N = {πd}^{2}\sigma = 2\pi Rh \sigma$

$= 2 \times 3.14 \times 6400 \times 0.1 \times 1000$

$= 2 \times 3.14 \times 6.4 \times {10}^{5} = 4 \times {10}^{6}$
